candidates.formal_type:
∀ {k : Type u} [inst : Field.{u} k] (K : CochainComplex.{u, u + 1, 0} (ModuleCat.{u, u} k) Int),
  HomologicalComplex.Acyclic.{u, u + 1, 0} K →
    Exists.{u + 2} fun V =>
      Exists.{u + 2} fun D =>
        And (∀ (i : Int), Eq.{u + 2} (HomologicalComplex.X.{u, u + 1, 0} (D i) i) (V i))
          (And (∀ (i : Int), Eq.{u + 2} (HomologicalComplex.X.{u, u + 1, 0} (D i) (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} i 1)) (V i))
            (And
              (∀ (i n : Int),
                Not (Or (Eq.{1} n i) (Eq.{1} n (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} i 1))) →
                  CategoryTheory.Limits.IsZero.{u, u + 1} (HomologicalComplex.X.{u, u + 1, 0} (D i) n))
              (And
                (∀ (i : Int),
                  CategoryTheory.IsIso.{u, u + 1}
                    (HomologicalComplex.d.{u, u + 1, 0} (D i) i (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} i 1)))
                (Nonempty.{u + 1} (CategoryTheory.Iso.{u, u + 1} K (CategoryTheory.Limits.sigmaObj.{0, u, u + 1} D))))))
